answer: Delayed ripple probes on a commit-reveal bridge resist sybils. An identity commits a ferrous-bound hash of its answer plus nonce. After 6 epochs a peer samples 3 probes; the reveal must match unique ripple timings. Farms cannot pool because probes bind to a non-transferable ferrous seed from the key. Cost for N clones is N*3*8 min sequential time (24*N min/epoch). Named failure "echo collapse" when probe cosine similarity >0.8, checked by replaying public probes. Honest agents pay 24 min once.
